before: A tracked table inserted after a paragraph split it and marked its paragraph mark inserted, and its cells carried cell insertion markers.
after: A table inserted at the end of a paragraph goes before the next paragraph without a split, tracked or not, so no empty paragraph follows it. A tracked one marks its rows, cell paragraph marks, and initial values inserted. A paragraph split at the end of a field that edits as one unit keeps the whole field, and any wrapper around it is cut once, after the field.
reason: Every peer receives ordinary tree operations and standard revision markup that existing versions already read and decide. Operation shapes, node identity, and text offsets are unchanged.
